title: Completeness of the specified actual quotient-cone augmentation
statement: Fix the finite field datum D with geometric field k and characteristic p, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension E of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with integer ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, as in [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Let R be the completed integral coefficient sheaf on s, and let $A_n$ be its finite constant coefficient quotient $\mathcal O_E/(\varpi^{n+1})$ for $n\in\mathbf N$, as in [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Let P be a flat-term K-flat good complex of R-modules as in [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined], with $[P]$ integral constructible and derived complete as in [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Write $D_n=\Gamma(s,\operatorname{Res}(P\otimes_R A_n))$ for the actual ordinary quotient tower with its specified quotient transitions, with scalar action restricted to the single integral coefficient ring $\mathcal O_E$. Let H be the concrete two-product Roos cocone, the mapping fibre of one minus the transition shift, from [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. The map $a_P:\Gamma(s,P)\to H(D_\bullet)$ of [lem-trf-point-transport-cone-comparison-descent], whose unshifted product coordinate consists of the quotient units and whose shifted coordinate is zero, becomes an isomorphism after localization in the fixed small derived category of integral coefficient modules.

source.place: clause *(3)*: the integral point transport is the derived limit of the levelwise maps, via its specified cone map

proof.text: Identify the identity-extension scalar tower with the actual quotient tower by the canonical balanced tensor identification. It sends 1 tensor x to 1 tensor x, commutes with the quotient transitions, and therefore is an isomorphism of whole strict towers.

Realize that identification diagonally on both Roos coordinates and apply exact point sections. The normalized source completion comparison of pointSectionsCompletionCone has quotient-unit first coordinate and zero shifted coordinate. Joint extensionality of these two coordinates identifies it with the specified actual quotient augmentation. Derived completeness makes the comparison invertible.

mathlib_searches.query: exact evaluation commutes with the mapping cone realization of a strict inverse tower of complexes
mathlib_searches.results: MappingCone functoriality and mapHomologicalComplex comparisons only; no specific quotient transport or completeness unit theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: exact point sections of the canonical completion unit of a derived complete complex is an isomorphism
mathlib_searches.results: Completion of normed modules and general Kan-extension units; no coefficient sheaf completion or specified point transport.
mappingCocone.lift and its two projection formulas supply the cone assembly, but neither of the coefficient-specific assertions.

Sheaf PointTransportStrictQuotient states its laws only on good complexes. PointSectionsCompletionCone uses integralScalarTowerFunctor rather than the actual unrestricted quotient tower. No existing ordinary-module theorem states these exact interfaces. Mathlib only has generic cone functoriality.
